basis: Owner directives 2026-10-23: real cinematic motion instead of still images (licensed footage allowed), '4 to 7 s shots, bet on dynamics', 'the first 3 seconds must be devastating', 'never below 1440p'. Technical and speech gates copied from pilot-qa-criteria-v3 except the frame (2560x1440). Grammar: 4-7 s shots; the opening shot is real footage carrying the spoken hook line (no still title card; evidence/vidiq/20261023/hook_audit.md), so title_card_seconds measures that opening shot; >= 60 % of the picture time real footage; same repeat gap, captions and CTA rules. Rights: FLUX/SDXL stills as in v3 plus footage only under an accepted licence, vetted (no people, text or branding) and credited. Amended before any v4 render; pilot-qa-criteria-v3 stays frozen and unchanged.

technical.video: 2560x1440, H.264, 30 fps, one audio stream (AAC 48 kHz stereo)

failure_policy: Any FAIL blocks approval; criteria are not edited after results to pass.
not_claimed: Audience response, CTR, retention or revenue
perceptual_review_required_before_approv: Watched review (long_review.watch); owner floor: overall >= 9.5 for new uploads.
